copy.heading: Seasonal obligations

items.label: April - cut the grass once.
items.note: The first cut is ceremonial and may be photographed.

items.label: June - cut the grass again.
items.note: Enthusiasm at this point is a warning sign.

items.label: August - cut the grass, or do not.
items.note: August is understood to be a negotiation.

items.label: October - move the furniture into the shed.
February - look at the garden from the window.

copy.footnote: No other obligation exists. Any additional task the subject performs is voluntary and should not be mentioned to the household, who will come to expect it.
